title: Plant 10 Trees
subtitle: Join our eco community
description: Join the community to plant 10 trees this month. Every tree you plant helps reduce carbon footprint, supports local biodiversity, and improves air quality.

title: Reduce Plastic Usage
subtitle: Say no to single-use plastics
description: Take actionable steps to minimize single-use plastics in your daily life. Learn alternatives, reduce waste, and help protect oceans and wildlife from plastic pollution.

title: Clean Your Neighborhood
subtitle: Participate in local cleanup
description: Join community cleanup drives to remove litter, promote recycling, and create cleaner streets and parks.

title: Save Water
subtitle: Small steps, big impact
description: Adopt water-saving habits at home and workplace. Reduce wastage through mindful usage, repair leaks, and promote water conservation.

title: Switch to Renewable Energy
subtitle: Clean energy for a brighter future
description: Shift towards renewable energy sources like solar and wind. Reduce dependency on fossil fuels, cut down carbon emissions, and support sustainable energy adoption.

title: Support Local Eco Businesses
subtitle: Shop consciously
description: Promote sustainable products by supporting eco-friendly businesses in your area. Encourage green practices and help your community thrive sustainably.

title: Compost Organic Waste
subtitle: Turn waste into resources
description: Learn to compost food scraps and yard waste to create natural fertilizer. Reduce landfill waste and improve soil health.

title: Use Public Transport
subtitle: Reduce carbon footprint
description: Opt for public transport, cycling, or walking instead of driving alone to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
